windows.notes: Winter wheat sown early-mid Oct (Hebei north wheat zone 9/27-10/4, south plain 10/5-10/15; Henan 10/5-10/12). Rotation partner of summer maize.
Winter wheat harvested June (Jun 10-15 in field trial).
Summer maize sown mid-late Jun (Jun 15-20), immediately after wheat harvest. Kept separate from Northeast spring maize.
Summer maize harvested Sep per mapping studies; Oct 10-15 in field trial.
Spring maize sown late Apr-early May (Apr 28-May 15 in trials). Single-crop system.
Spring maize harvested late Sep-early Oct.
Early rice (double-crop) sown late Mar; transplanted late Apr-early May. South China double-cropping zone (SCDR).
Late rice (double-crop) transplanted late Jul-early Aug (nursery sown Jun 15-25). Rush-harvesting/rush-planting window.
